content:
First, convert speeds to m/s:  
Car speed \( v_s = 108 \text{ km/h} = 30 \text{ m/s} \)  
Camera speed \( v_o = 72 \text{ km/h} = 20 \text{ m/s} \)  

Both moving in same direction, so relative motion:  
Source moving toward observer at \( v_s = 30 \) m/s, observer moving toward source at \( v_o = 20 \) m/s.  

Use Doppler formula for sound in air (speed of sound \( c \approx 343 \) m/s):  

\[
f' = f \cdot \frac{c + v_o}{c - v_s}
\]

\[
f' = 800 \cdot \frac{343 + 20}{343 - 30}
\]

\[
f' = 800 \cdot \frac{363}{313}
\]

\[
\frac{363}{313} \approx 1.1597
\]

\[
f' \approx 800 \times 1.1597 \approx 927.76 \ \text{Hz}
\]

Closest option: 924 Hz.  

Final answer: (C)
